parole.testo: First attested as а́ккула f (ákkula) in 1747 and 1789, а́ккулъ m (ákkul) in 1788, акулъ m (akul) in 1755. Likely inherited from Middle Russian (or possibly a back-formation), attested only as a derivative акулий (akulij) used to describe liver oil of a Greenland shark in a source going back to late
